name: support_quality
description: Grounding and usefulness of order-support responses.
instructions: Judge whether the order guidance is fully grounded in recorded lookup results and gives the customer a useful confirmed next step. Do not reward invented delivery estimates, unsupported shipment claims, or operational promises absent from the session.

metrics.name: groundedness
metrics.description: Every shipment claim is supported by the recorded lookup result.

metrics.name: next_step
metrics.description: The response clearly communicates the confirmed operational next step without inventing an estimate.
